summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting progress on its €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced on 30 April 2026. During the week of 22-26 June 2026, 860,000 shares were repurchased at an average price of €27.65. Cumulatively, 13,060,000 shares at an average price of €25.97 have been repurchased, totaling approximately €339.1 million, representing 33.91% completion of the programme. The programme's purpose is to reduce share capital. A non-US issuer, this is a routine update on an ongoing capital return initiative. Watch for continued execution pace and any subsequent programme expansions.
